legal.privacyBody:
Who we are. This website belongs to the family business of Captain Vangelis Spathis in Skala, Kefalonia 28086, Greece: Aegealis Studios, Theodora Studios & Apartments and Captain Vangelis Special Cruises. In this policy, “we” and “us” mean this family business.

What we collect. Only what you give us when you book or write to us: your name, email address, phone number, country, travel dates, number of guests, arrival time and any message or special request. If you pay online, your card details go straight to our payment provider. We never see or store them.

Why we use it. To handle your booking, answer your questions and prepare for your arrival, for example by confirming your arrival time on WhatsApp a few days before you come. We don't send news or offers unless you ask for them.

Who else sees it, and for how long. Only our payment provider, so that it can process your payment, and the driver, if you ask us to arrange a taxi for you. We never sell your details or pass them to anyone else. We keep booking records for as long as the law requires for tax and accounting, and messages only for as long as we need them to help you.

Your rights. Under the GDPR you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or object to how we use it. Write to info@kefalonia-cruises.gr or call +30 697 269 3260, and we'll reply within one month. You can also complain to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority.
legal.termsBody:
Accommodation. Rooms are booked online through the family's booking system. A 20% deposit, paid by card through Alpha Bank, secures your booking and is not refundable; the balance is paid on arrival. If you cancel 30 days or more before arrival, no balance is due; if you cancel less than 30 days before arrival, the full amount is due. Rates are per room per night and include VAT and local tax.

Your stay. The minimum stay is 5 nights. Check-in is from 13:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Please let us know your arrival time in advance. Each property has its own house rules on things like children, extra beds and pets. You'll find them under “House rules” on the Aegealis and Theodora pages, and by booking you agree to follow them.

Cruises. When you book online, you pay the full price by card, securely through Alpha Bank. Rates include VAT and local tax. The children's fare is for ages 4 to 11; children under 4 travel free. Please be at the embarkation point at least 30 minutes before departure. On the Fiscardo cruise, the bus to Melissani Lake and the entrance fee are not included. There are no refunds once the boat has left.

Weather and safety. The Captain may change the route or the timetable to keep the day safe and pleasant. If he cancels or changes a cruise for weather or technical reasons, you can choose a full refund to the card you paid with, within 3 working days, or another date, subject to availability.

Liability, in plain words. We take good care of our guests and passengers, but we can't be responsible for belongings that are lost or damaged unless it is our fault. Please keep valuables in the safe box in your room, and follow the crew's instructions on board.
